normal.text: Very sad, but not terribly surprised that EA has shut down #bioware. EA has been a mess for a while... Their recent buyout, I expect, is just further running it into the ground. Else, I hope #exodus by #ArchetypeEntertainment really steps in to have that spirit live on! #gaming #videogames #SadNews
